name: Teemo
title: the Swift Scout

Q.name: Blinding Dart
Q.description: Teemo fires a dart, Blinding the target for 2/2.25/2.5/2.75/3 seconds and dealing 80/125/170/215/260 + 0.7×AP magic damage.
Q.summary: Obscures an enemy's vision with a powerful venom, dealing damage to the target unit and blinding it for the duration.

W.name: Move Quick
W.description: Passive: Teemo gains 12/16/20/24/28.0% Move Speed while he hasn't been damaged by a champion or turret in the last 5 seconds. Active: Teemo sprints, gaining 24/32/40/48/56.0% Move Speed that is not lost when struck for 3 seconds.
W.summary: Teemo scampers around, passively increasing his Move Speed until he is struck by an enemy champion or turret. Teemo can sprint to gain bonus Move Speed that isn't stopped by being struck for a short time.

E.name: Toxic Shot
E.description: Passive: Teemo's Attacks apply poison %i:OnHit% On-Hit, dealing an additional 9/23/37/51/65 + 0.3×AP + 0.05×bonus AD magic damage plus (6/12/18/24/30 + 0.1×AP + 0.025×bonus AD) × 4 magic damage over 4 seconds.
E.summary: Each of Teemo's attacks will poison the target %i:OnHit% On-Hit, dealing damage on impact and each second after for 4 seconds.

R.name: Noxious Trap
R.description: Teemo tosses a mushroom trap that detonates when stepped on. The traps Slow by 30/40/50% and deal 200/325/450 + 0.5×AP magic damage over 4 seconds. Enemies are revealed for the same duration. Traps last 5 minutes and are stealthed. A mushroom tossed onto another mushroom bounces before landing at its position. This Ability has 3/4/5 charges ((varies) second refresh).
R.summary: Teemo throws an explosive poisonous trap using one of the mushrooms stored in his pack. If an enemy steps on the trap, it will release a poisonous cloud, slowing enemies and damaging them over time. If Teemo throws a mushroom onto another mushroom it will bounce, gaining additional range.

Passive.name: Guerrilla Warfare
Passive.description: If Teemo stands still and takes no actions for a short duration, he becomes Invisible indefinitely. If he's in brush, Teemo can enter and maintain his Invisibility while moving. After leaving Invisibility, Teemo gains the Element of Surprise, increasing his Attack Speed for a few seconds.
Passive.summary: If Teemo stands still and takes no actions for a short duration, he becomes Invisible indefinitely. If he's in brush, Teemo can enter and maintain his Invisibility while moving. After leaving Invisibility, Teemo gains the Element of Surprise, increasing his Attack Speed for a few seconds.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Teemo is a ranged top laner who harasses melee champions with Toxic Shot and shuts down auto attackers with Blinding Dart. He controls the map with stealthed Noxious Trap mushrooms.
strengths: Blinding Dart blinds the target, so auto attackers cannot trade back.
Toxic Shot adds poison to every attack, so short trades keep dealing damage.
Ranged against melee champions, with W passive move speed to dodge and kite.
Noxious Traps slow, damage, and give vision, controlling the map late.
Guerrilla Warfare makes him invisible while standing still, so he can ambush.
weaknesses: No hard CC: his only CC is blind and slow.
Weak in teamfights compared to other top laners.
Mushrooms can be cleared by Oracle Lens and control wards.
Struggles against ranged top laners and champions who can ignore blind.

curve.lvl1: strong – range and Toxic Shot against melee champions
curve.lvl2: strong – Blinding Dart stops auto attackers from trading back
curve.lvl3: strong – W active move speed lets him kite melee all-ins
curve.lvl6: good – Noxious Traps zone areas and give vision
curve.items: medium – first item: Nashor's Tooth or Liandry's Torment for AP; or on-hit items
curve.late: okay – zones with mushrooms but is weak in teamfights

profile.curveNote: Teemo is strong from level 1 thanks to range and blind against melee champions. Mushrooms make him a map-control threat later.
profile.waveClear: Okay: poison on attacks clears waves slowly.
profile.mobility: Good: W passive and active move speed.

keyAbilities.trading: Q (Blinding Dart) blind, then auto attacks with Toxic Shot
keyAbilities.answers: None. Teemo has no spell shield or dodge.

Passive.notes: Guerrilla Warfare: invisible after standing still or moving through brush; attack speed after leaving invisibility.

Q.answer: Cleanse removes blind; point-and-click, so it cannot be dodged.
Q.notes: Blinding Dart: a point-and-click blind; stops auto attacks.

W.notes: Move Quick: passive move speed while not damaged; active doubles it and isn't lost when hit.

E.answer: Jax E dodges; Fiora W parries.
E.notes: Toxic Shot: poison on his attacks.

R.notes: Noxious Trap: invisible mushrooms that slow, poison and reveal.

profile.windowAgainst: Teemo's window is when Blinding Dart is on cooldown: he cannot stop auto attacks, and has no escape apart from move speed.
